reason: ₹22,000 is more than a whole month of what our house earns, and a plain semi-automatic is half that. The power cuts are a real headache, but my hands and a bucket still work for free, and I won't spend this kind of money outside Diwali or harvest time anyway.
objection: I'd be paying double just for a battery that does two loads. Even ₹1,999 a month for a year is a big fixed bill when our income comes in lumps after harvest, and if that battery dies in the village who comes to fix it?
would_change_my_mind: A Diwali or harvest-season offer that brings it near ₹15,000 with a free gift, EMI I can pay after harvest instead of every month, and a neighbour I know already using it without trouble.
